study.question: Does centered auxiliary transfer require both click-parallel and click-orthogonal components at their original magnitudes, or did full-norm rescaling obscure a sufficient single component?
study.hypothesis: Let C be the FP64 aggregate auxiliary product-context cotangent centered over occupied rows and K the similarly centered click-only cotangent. Let P=proj_K(C), O=C-P, with P=0 and O=C for K=0. The latest normalized single-component arms both underperformed C: C=0.6682972490, norm-matched O=0.6681098137, norm-matched P=0.6678762177, blocked=0.6678548721. This is local single-seed evidence, not proof that both components are needed: normalization changes their native magnitudes. Working hypothesis: retaining both signed components at native magnitude is more useful than either deletion. Native O may alternatively recover C if amplifying O caused the previous deficit. Native P alone is expected near blocked. The experiment distinguishes these explanations without choosing a new architecture or altering private supervision.

nearest_work.difference: Closest local method. Inherit its four-output identity collector, aggregate FP64 centering, global click-relative projection, normalization computations and entire Model. Add selection of unrescaled P or O. Compare against its norm-matched component trials only after same-topology C/blocked replay bridges pass.

Prior row-space reflection reverses a component while preserving total row norm. Deletion instead removes one component at native magnitude. Reflection is a different intervention and does not establish component sufficiency.

inherited_components: Complete strongest local compressed-history product-context forward model with task-specific residuals, moments and rank16 product adapters
Frozen task masks and offline historical actions, unchanged four prediction heads and ordinary joint BCE
Latest successful joint collector and FP64 occupied-row geometry, including original handling of zero references
All normalization computations retained in every arm to match latest comparison work; normalized outputs are deliberately not selected
study.proposed_difference: Four-cell 2x2 deletion policy: both components via direct C, P only at native magnitude, O only at native magnitude, or zero. Modify only selection of the auxiliary context VJP after the inherited decomposition. Both-present uses C directly, avoiding P+O reconstruction as a new rounding confound. Every arm computes P, O and the inherited norm-matched versions in the same order. All outputs of the collector are identity views. This prescribed first-order surrogate backward is not the derivative of the identity forward, a new scalar objective, or a parameter-space gradient projection method.
predictions: C replay and blocked replay reproduce their latest receipts under the frozen deterministic recipe; any unexplained deviation is an implementation/reproducibility issue before a mechanism inference.
If both native components are useful, click AUC(C) exceeds both single-component policies; O exceeds blocked and P is near blocked.
If full-norm O harmed learning through amplification, native O recovers or exceeds C and outperforms historical norm-matched O once bridges pass.
At a shared fixed state, forward outputs and private task gradients agree across arms; only aggregate context-input cotangent differs. No inference capacity change is expected.
falsifiers: A native single-component policy reproducing or outperforming C contradicts the claim that both components are necessary in this setting.
O at native magnitude failing to improve on norm-matched O weakens the amplification explanation; repeat decisive differences before drawing a stable conclusion.
C or either native component not outperforming blocked across paired repetitions would undermine useful centered auxiliary transfer at this starting point.
Mask leakage, changed forward/private gradients, invalid component identities, nonfinite values, or unexplained native/blocked replay mismatch invalidate attribution regardless of performance.
alternative_explanations: Adaptive Adagrad, repeated context IDs, and trajectory changes can produce effects unrelated to parameter-space alignment.
Native deletion trades direction for magnitude, so its contrast with historical full-norm interventions is essential; neither study alone isolates all optimization effects.

Previous FP32 collected task/aggregate results differed, whereas FP64 converged to the same AUC; direct task-centered and collected paths also differed. Historical direct-path gains must not be treated as matched evidence for this collector.

The prior one-task subsets and scaled losses did not recover joint performance, but this does not prove task synergy. Prior shifted labels harmed click; distribution-preserving shifting is not an independence guarantee.
AUC and logloss can move differently, and small validation differences after many searches may not repeat. Identical same-seed replays are not independent confirmations.
Archived successes do not certify every suggested numerical gate: latest receipts report candidate_diagnostics=not_requested. New host gates remain required, not presumed passed.

validation_plan.local_checks: Parse/compile sources without importing torch; enforce allowed imports, literal CONFIG, identical model/training_loss AST across variants except transfer default, and no filesystem/network operations. No tensor execution or training in coding jail.
host_preflight: Under authorized host only: test _click_relative_components on all-empty, one occupied row, zero K, zero C, exactly parallel and exactly orthogonal synthetic FP64 tensors, mixed masks, repeated context IDs and very small nonzero K. Require finite values, zero unoccupied transfer, C=P+O and <P,O>=0 to FP64 tolerance1e-10 relative to relevant norms (absolute floor1e-24 for residual comparisons); check exact-zero convention separately.

Compare each reduction to independent reference: click_gradient + selected_transfer.cast(click_dtype). FP64 selector tolerance1e-10 relative, FP32 tolerance1e-5, BF16 tolerance2e-2 where arithmetic is not exact; identical explicit-cast expression should match exactly. No finite-difference derivative test of identity forward: this is an intentional surrogate VJP.

Load identical state and verify training forward outputs, Dice buffers, loss values and all private module gradients across cells using synthetic nonzero task cotangents; only prescribed context-input VJP changes. Verify true-label BCE and no labels in forward.

Forward/backward/masking smoke check at full frozen training shape and eval remainder, including odd/singleton eval batches. Collector is training-only. Confirm auxiliary item/scorer/tower/residual-context routes stay blocked, ordinary private gradients stay enabled, and no new parameters or buffers appear.

Record pre-cast norms of C/P/O, P:C and O:C ratios, global projection coefficient/sign, degenerate fractions and postcast errors if authorized host diagnostics support this. Source receipts currently expose no such measurements; report missing diagnostics explicitly rather than inventing observations. Do not add a new evaluation interface or make parameter-space claims.
